1.text: Hiramu umwami w'i Tiro yohereza intumwa kuri Dawidi, n'ibiti by'imyerezi n'abazi kubakisha amabuye n'ababaji, ngo bamwubakire inzu.

2.text: Nuko Dawidi amenya ko Uwiteka amukomereje ubwami bwa Isirayeli ngo bube ubwe, kuko ubwami bwe bwashyiriwe hejuru ku bw'ubwoko bwe bw'Abisirayeli.

3.text: Bukeye Dawidi yongera kurongora abandi bagore ari i Yerusalemu, yongera kubyara abana b'abahungu n'abakobwa.

4.text: Kandi aya ni yo mazina y'abana yabyariye i Yerusalemu: Shamuwa na Shobabu na Natani na Salomo,

5.text: na Ibuhari na Elishuwa na Elifeleti,

6.text: na Noga na Nefegi na Yafiya,

7.text: na Elishama na Bēliyada na Elifeleti.

8.text: Abafilisitiya bumvise ko Dawidi yimikishijwe amavuta ngo abe umwami wa Isirayeli yose, Abafilisitiya bose bazamurwa no kumutera. Dawidi abyumvise arabasanganira.

9.text: Icyo gihe Abafilisitiya baraje buzura ikibaya cy'Abarafa.

10.text: Dawidi agisha Imana inama ati “Ntere Abafilisitiya uzabangabiza?”Uwiteka aramusubiza ati “Genda kuko nzabakugabiza.”

11.text: Nuko bazamukira i Bāliperasimu, Dawidi abatsindayo. Dawidi aherako aravuga ati “Imana yahomboje abanzi banjye ukuboko kwanjye nk'uko amazi ahomboka.” Ni cyo cyatumye aho hantu bahahimba Bāliperasimu.

12.text: Kandi Abafilisitiya batayo ibigirwamana byabo, Dawidi ategeka ko babitwika.

13.text: Bukeye Abafilisitiya bongera kuzura cya kibaya.

14.text: Dawidi yongera kugisha Imana inama. Imana iramubwira iti “We gutabara ubakurikiye, ahubwo ubace rubete ubarasukireho ahateganye n'ishyamba ry'imitugunguru.

15.text: Nuko niwumva ikiriri kirangīra hejuru y'ubushorishori bw'imitugunguru, uhereko utabare kuko Imana iri bube igutabariye imbere kunesha ingabo z'Abafilisitiya.”

16.text: Nuko Dawidi abigenza uko Imana yamutegetse, batsinda ingabo z'Abafilisitiya uhereye i Gibeyoni ukageza i Gezeri.

17.text: Maze inkuru ya Dawidi yamamara mu bihugu byose, Uwiteka atuma amahanga yose amutinya.
